command: set -euo pipefail; rm -rf "$TMPDIR/m22-verify-sim-shards" "$TMPDIR/m22-verify-merged"; python3 -c "import glob,json,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; b=json.load(open('scripts/test-shards-baseline.json')); rs=[ET.parse(p).getroot() for p in glob.glob('apps/*/target/surefire-reports/TEST-*.xml')+glob.glob('platform/*/target/surefire-reports/TEST-*.xml')]; agg=(len(rs),sum(int(r.get('tests')) for r in rs),sum(int(r.get('failures')) for r in rs),sum(int(r.get('errors')) for r in rs),sum(int(r.get('skipped')) for r in rs),round(sum(float(r.get('time')) for r in rs),3),{r.get('name'):int(r.get('tests')) for r in rs}); base=(b['suite_count'],b['test_count'],b['failure_count'],b['error_count'],b['skip_count'],b['time_total_seconds'],{c['class']:c['tests'] for c in b['classes']}); assert agg==base, (agg[:6],base[:6]); print('BASELINE_MATCH', agg[:6])"; node scripts/test-shards.mjs --check; node scripts/test-shards.mjs --simulate "$TMPDIR/m22-verify-sim-shards" --reports-root .; node scripts/test-merge-shards.mjs --shards-root "$TMPDIR/m22-verify-sim-shards" --out-dir "$TMPDIR/m22-verify-merged"
